# htm + Preact standalone

`standalone.module.js` is htm 3.1.1's `preact/standalone.module.js` distribution, which bundles Preact 10, hooks, and htm into one ES module with no imports. It is loaded from disk for the offline editor; no package installation or source build is needed.

Sources: [htm 3.1.1](https://github.com/developit/htm/tree/3.1.1), [standalone distribution](https://unpkg.com/htm@3.1.1/preact/standalone.module.js), [Preact](https://github.com/preactjs/preact). htm is Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-htm`); Preact is MIT (`LICENSE-preact`). The editor distribution includes the module and both licenses.
